title: D6 Trap Catalog
resolution: A creature notices or disables a trap with an INT check against its DC. A triggered trap uses its listed save and damage.

traps.name: Poison Needle Lock
traps.trigger: Opening a trapped lock without disarming it
traps.effect: On a failed save, the target is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

traps.name: Falling Stones
traps.effect: On a successful save, take half damage; the route becomes blocked.

traps.name: Fire Rune
traps.trigger: Touching or crossing the marked threshold
traps.effect: The rune flashes and burns creatures in a 10 ft area; half damage on a successful save.

traps.name: Weighted Net Snare
traps.trigger: Stepping on a concealed pressure plate
traps.effect: The target is restrained until it uses an action and succeeds on a CON or DEX DC 9 check.

traps.name: Archive Alarm Seal
traps.effect: Raises an alarm and awakens one additional archive guardian.
